infobox.usage: Unlocks the Tarcone director's office in the red Paradigm warehouse on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tarcone Director's office key (Director's) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to Tarcone director's administrative office, located in the customs control warehouse.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - The second room is a mandatory quest location for the quests Delivery From the Past and Farming

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The door to the second room must be breached

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

- On a metal shelf in the storage room of the new gas station.

- Warehouse #3 at the crane yard, on the ground next to the dead body.

- Warehouse #5 at the crane yard, on the shelf with the water tanks next to the blue delivery van.

- In a bunkhouse on the southern side of the courtyard of the "Big Red" warehouse, located in the cabinet under the plant

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key can be used at the top of the staircase in the eastern red Paradigm warehouse on the map Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Health Resort east wing room 306 key spawn location
- 1× Sport bag
- 3× PC blocks
- 1× Safe
- 1× Jacket
- 1× Flyye MBSS backpack (UCP) spawn
- 1× PACA Soft Armor spawn
- 1× Intelligence folder spawn
- Loose loot
